A directly relevant thermal-conductivity/304 record was already available, but aggregate BM25 token coverage preferred and admitted an ignition-temperature/302 source because generic subject tokens outweighed missing decision-property and operand-role anchors. Materialization and metadata-refined provenance preservation occur later and are therefore downstream defects, not the first Task C causal gap.
